content.text:
I've traced the full chain. Here's what I found.

## #130 — "ensure that `todo_create` accepts body and tags"

**The claim is true.** `todo_create` accepts *only* `title`. Body and tags cannot be supplied at creation time — they're dropped.

### The chain, top to bottom

1. **Published MCP schema** — `TodoCreateArgs` (`crates/panopt-tool-surface/src/params.rs:78-82`) declares a single required field, `title: String`. No `body`, no `tags`. This is the schema the proxy publishes in `tools/list`, so to an MCP client validating args against it, `body`/`tags` are disallowed properties → "rejected."

2. **Daemon handler** — `todo_create` (`crates/panoptd/src/handler.rs:830-841`) forwards only `args.title` to core. (Note: the struct has no `deny_unknown_fields`, so server-side any stray `body`/`tags` keys are *silently ignored* rather than erroring — but they're lost either way.)

3. **Core** — `Store::todo_create(project, title)` (`crates/panopt-core/src/state.rs:1002-1021`) INSERTs only `title` + `status='open'` + timestamps. `body` and `tags` columns fall to their defaults (empty body, `NULL`/`[]` tags).

### It's a known limitation, not a bug

The CLI form code already documents the workaround. `crates/panopt/src/todo_form.rs:985-990`:
> `todo_create` accepts only `title`; the daemon initialises [the rest]…

So today the only way to set body/tags is **create-then-update**: call `todo_create`, then `todo_update` (which *does* accept both — `params.rs:119-142`). Both CLI callers (`todo.rs:151`, `todo_form.rs:985`) send `json!({ "title": title })` and rely on a follow-up update.

### What a fix requires

`todo_update` already has the persistence logic (`state.rs:1144-1147` writes tags as JSON; body is a plain column). To let `todo_create` accept them:

1. **`params.rs`** — add `#[serde(default)] body: Option<String>` and `tags: Option<Vec<String>>` to `TodoCreateArgs`.
2. **`state.rs`** — extend `Store::todo_create` to take and persist body/tags. ⚠️ Signature change ripples through **~30 call sites** in the test module (all `todo_create(p, "a".into())`). Cleanest options: take a `TodoDraft`/`Default`-able struct, or keep the 2-arg method and add a `todo_create_full`, or insert-then-reuse the update path.
3. **`handler.rs:838`** — thread the new args through.
4. Optionally update the two CLI callers to pass body/tags inline and drop their create-then-update dance.

This is a clean, well-scoped change — the hard part (validation + persistence) already exists in `todo_update`.

Want me to implement it? If so, I'd lean toward changing the core signature to take a small `TodoDraft { title, body, tags }` struct so the test call sites update mechanically and future fields are cheap to add.

Confirmed — every "sensible default" you'd want already lives in the schema as a column default:

| field | default (`db.rs:54-57`) |
|---|---|
| `body` | `''` |
| `priority` | `'medium'` |
| `assignee` | `''` |
| `tags` | `'[]'` |
| `status` | `'open'` (set explicitly in `todo_create`) |

So your instinct is exactly right: the storage layer is *already* default-everything. The current `todo_create` INSERT just names `title, status, created_at, updated_at` and lets the rest fall to those defaults. Making the API accept the full optional surface doesn't require inventing defaults — it just means "write the column when supplied, otherwise let the existing default stand."

The one field I'd *not* make optional is `title`: an empty-title todo is meaningless, and the CLI form already refuses to create one (`todo_form.rs:954`). So the shape becomes "`todo_update`'s surface, minus `todo_id`, with `title` required" — symmetric and predictable.

## What changed

`todo_create` now accepts the full optional surface, with `title` the only required field. Everything else falls back to the schema defaults you already had:

- **`crates/panopt-tool-surface/src/params.rs`** — `TodoCreateArgs` gains optional `body`, `status`, `priority`, `assignee`, `tags` (mirrors `TodoUpdateArgs` minus `todo_id`).
- **`crates/panopt-tool-surface/src/lib.rs`** — `TOOL_SURFACE` description updated so `tools/list` advertises the new fields and their defaults.
- **`crates/panoptd/src/handler.rs`** — `todo_create` validates `status`/`priority` *before* inserting (a bad enum value errors out with no orphan row), then applies a `TodoPatch` to the new row only when the caller actually supplied extras. Unset fields never touch the row, so the DB column defaults stand.

I deliberately left the core `Store::todo_create(project, title)` signature alone — reusing the existing, already-tested `todo_update` path avoids churning ~30 test call sites and duplicating the default knowledge that already lives in the schema. Both the create and the optional patch run under a single state-lock acquisition, so no other agent interleaves between them.

The two CLI callers still pass `json!({ "title": title })` — unaffected, since the new fields are optional.

## Notes

- **Not yet live in a running daemon.** Daemon code changed, so a running `panoptd` won't have it until `just stop && just up` (or `just refresh`).
- **#130 itself** — this fix resolves it. Say the word (`mac`) and I'll mark it complete; I left it open since I haven't verified against a live daemon yet.
